summary: Following/reverse-chron gained dedicated viewer muted-keyword filtering while the For You path renamed its mute filter to a viewer-specific implementation.
why_it_matters: CHAOS RANK reach diagnosis must separate viewer-controlled mute suppression in Following from platform safety labels and For You ranking effects.
do_not_conclude: A post missing from one viewer's Following feed is not evidence of an account-wide visibility penalty.
next_action: Add viewer-preference suppression as a distinct diagnostic cause in visibility analysis.

summary: The published home_direct_packed Phoenix configuration enabled author-follow-direction inputs and engagement-count features.
why_it_matters: Phoenix can represent relationship direction and popularity directly in the published model configuration instead of relying only on downstream heuristics.
do_not_conclude: The public config alone does not prove the same checkpoint/config is serving all production traffic.
next_action: Track checkpoint/config deployment evidence and design matched-post tests for relationship-direction effects.

summary: The published home_direct_packed configuration explicitly enabled stale-post handling.
why_it_matters: Content age can become an explicit model input/treatment boundary rather than being represented only through generic recency behavior.
do_not_conclude: This does not establish that every production ranking request currently uses the same stale-post configuration.
next_action: Track behavior around the 14-day boundary and seek serving-config evidence before promotion to VERIFIED.

summary: Grok 4.6 internal was added to safety-policy processing with a published 0.1 dial alongside Grok 4.5 internal paths.
why_it_matters: Safety and visibility-label outcomes can shift because of model-judge experiments even when rule registries remain unchanged.
do_not_conclude: A 10% model dial does not prove a 10% change in final labels or reach outcomes.
next_action: Track safety-label distributions and model-dial changes independently from explicit rule changes.
